api-controllers.title: API & Controllers
api-controllers.description: The Easy BPM Engine provides REST endpoints for managing processes, tasks, and forms. All endpoints are documented with OpenAPI/Swagger integration.

developer-quick-reference.title: Developer Quick Reference
developer-quick-reference.description: Quick guide for developers working with the Easy BPM Engine.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Find example process definitions in src/main/resources/examples/.

examples-readme.title: BPM Process Examples
examples-readme.description: This directory contains example BPMN process definitions that demonstrate various BPM engine capabilities, with focus on message event usage.

features-architecture.title: Features & Architecture
features-architecture.description: Easy BPM is a Spring Boot-based Business Process Management engine built in Kotlin. It provides a complete solution for deploying, executing, and monitoring BPMN-style processes.

implementation-status.title: BPM Engine - Implementation Status
implementation-status.description: Complete status of the Easy BPM Engine implementation including Phase 1 (Data Integrity), Phase 2 (Worker Architecture), and Phase 3 (Observability).

integration-testing.title: Integration Testing
integration-testing.description: Integration tests validate message event handling and process orchestration.

metrics-observability.title: Metrics & Observability (Phase 3)
metrics-observability.description: The Easy BPM Engine includes comprehensive observability features using Spring Boot Actuator and Micrometer. Monitor process execution, task performance, and system health in real-time.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Easy BPM is a Spring Boot-based BPM engine supporting BPMN-style process orchestration, message events, and integration with external systems. This documentation site provides guides, examples, and API references for developers and users.
